claim: AWS Graviton4 instance families arrived as follows: memory optimized R8g on July 9, 2024, and general purpose M8g and compute optimized C8g on September 25, 2024.
question: When did the Graviton4-based M8g, C8g and R8g instance families arrive?

values.spoken: M8g and C8g in September twenty twenty-four

evidence.quote: | [M8g instances](#doc-history) | New general purpose instances powered by AWS Graviton4 processors. | September 25, 2024 |
| [C8g instances](#doc-history) | New compute optimized instances powered by AWS Graviton4 processors. | September 25, 2024 |
| [R8g instances](#doc-history) | New memory optimized instances powered by AWS Graviton4 processors and up to 1.5 TiB memory. | July 9, 2024 |

note: d121. Use these current names in examples (m8g, c8g, r8g).

question: Which instance families use AWS Graviton5, and when did they arrive?
